I suppose we can self assign everybody who collaborates to split the reward. I don't think I would be able to truly focus on it until after NYE though.
This is for core team members only. @gentlementlegen the error message should be changed to be more clear.

@UbiquityOS draft me some automated telegram message outreach sequences. Keep it shorthand, and casual as it is an instant messaging platform - do not write it formal and email style.
The objective is to pique the recipients interest for them to reply. The context is that we're traveling to conferences this year and want to pitch our UbiquityOS solution to manage their remote software development teams more efficiently. Use any context you have on UbiquityOS to try and make a sequence of compelling messages that is likely to result in them replying and subsequently getting us a meeting with them in person during the conference. The recipients attended these conferences in the previous year and we are reaching out to them as we believe they are likely to attend again. 
The plain text of the attached document is as follows:
```
Hi {{FIRST_NAME}}, I am Miguel from Ubiquity DAO. 😁 A few of my community members asked about {{COMPANY}}, are you the right person to talk to in that aspect?
If didn't reply for 1 day
gm🖐, just bumping this up, mind if I share more information?
If didn't reply for 2 days
hey {{FIRST_NAME}}, just sharing our link so that you can see that we're legit😁: ubq.fi
If didn't reply for 2 days
hey, it seems like community building is not a priority right now. Feel free to reach out if that ever changes
If didn't reply for 3 days
{{FIRST_NAME}} ?
Upon receiving reply at any point, use these templates as appropriate:
Awesome! Well we’ve developed UbiquityOS—a sophisticated GitHub bot that's been fine-tuned over the past three years. It streamlines workflows by automating tasks and seamlessly integrates with GitHub to boost productivity. Plus, it offers automated, instant payments upon closing github issues, ensuring smooth and efficient transactions. You can check it out here: [ubq.fi](http://ubq.fi/).
How would it feel to get paid instantly every time your team completes tasks?
Cool! Will {{COMPANY}} be going to (insert soonest conference) by chance? If so, would be awesome to meet!
```
Keep emoji use to a minimum (or none)

I left some comments and my primary concern is that the initial messages before receiving a response does not explain anything about what we do and doesn't really give them a reason to want to respond. 
However, if we're messaging from an account with @ana-0k pictures, maybe they would reply just because she's a woman. 
Anyways, looking forward to hearing your rationale. Again, I left comments on the doc that you should review for context.
Maybe best to communicate directly on Telegram since they are on vacation now might not be checking GitHub much.
I am also UbiquityOS today
